*F-incoerc* (Incoercible, receipt-free computation) is part of *Secret Sharing, Threshold Cryptography, MPC* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

*References:*

- Alwen, Ostrovsky, Zhou, and Zikas. [*Incoercible multi-party computation and universally composable receipt-free voting*](https://web.cs.ucla.edu/~rafail/PUBLIC/182.pdf). In Advances in Cryptology – CRYPTO 2015, volume 9216 of LNCS, pages 763–780, 2015.
- Canetti and Gennaro. [*Incoercible multiparty computation*](https://eprint.iacr.org/1996/001). In 37th IEEE Symposium on Foundations of Computer Science (FOCS), 1996.
